simple.meaning: נֵכֶל (nêkel) is a Hebrew action word meaning “deceit.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Numbers, beginning at Numbers 25:18. The surrounding contexts include family, family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֵכֶל (H5231) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נֵכֶל (nêkel) / H5231 is traced through Numbers 25:18 with source-language evidence and verse context.
